_note: Design-day values for New Delhi, mid-May afternoon peak. Simplified: each surface is taken at its own peak irradiance (not simultaneous), which makes the result a conservative worst case. Replace with values processed from the ISHRAE New Delhi EPW file when available.

calibration._note: Lumped-capacitance term that stands in for thermal mass and conduction to the indoor air. Tuned so an unshaded 2-storey brick house peaks near 39 °C indoors. Replace with a proper dynamic simulation later.

energy._note: Assumed unconditioned baseline cooling demand, scaled by the change in heat gain. Assumption, not measured data.
